choices.content: Only their magnitudes need to be equal
Their magnitudes are equal and their directions are the same
Only their directions need to be the same
Their initial points must be the same

question.prompt: What does it mean for two vectors to be equal?

solutions.explanation: For nonzero vectors, equality means equal magnitudes and the same direction; two zero vectors are also equal. Equality does not depend on the initial points. Vectors can still be equal after translation. Therefore choose B.
solutions.title: Equality criterion
